mutants.description: reg_file's FAULT_TIME registers are given the age of the episode (timestamp_ms minus the episode-start snapshot) instead of the episode-start time itself, reading 'timestamp of the fault' as 'time since the fault'
mutants.reason: A host reading FTIME_0..2 after a logged fault gets a value that grows with every read instead of the frozen start time. With no fault logged (fault_time cleared to 0) it reads the live timestamp instead of zero.

mutants.description: fault_LED's 'strikes outstanding' is taken to mean strikes remaining before the latch (max_strikes - strike_level) instead of strikes accumulated
mutants.reason: After reset, with no strikes and the default nonzero strike limit, Red_LED1 blinks although nothing has happened. Once the accumulated count reaches the limit the blink stops unless a latch makes the LED solid.

mutants.description: The CPLD's trip drive latch_out is held on while the debounced SCR read-back is set, as if the gate drive had to sustain the SCR, instead of following strike_counter's latch_assert alone
mutants.reason: When the analog OVP fires the SCR, latch_out goes high and stays high until reset, though the CPLD never tripped. fault_cause then sees latch_assert set and stops logging the event as OVP.

mutants.description: The supervisor ignores input undervoltage during soft start, as if input-rail sag from the start-up inrush were expected and had to be blanked
mutants.reason: If a debounced UVLO occurs in S_SS, En stays high and the FSM does not go to S_OFF. The converter keeps switching until it reaches S_RUN, although the header says UVLO forces S_OFF from every state.

mutants.description: Host write data is bit-reversed before reg_file, as if spi_slave assembled bytes LSB-first, though the bus is MSB-first
mutants.reason: Every host write lands bit-reversed. A threshold write sets the wrong value, and the key bytes no longer match (0xA7 arrives as 0xE5), so unlock and disable writes fail. Reads are not affected.

after: always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
mutants.description: The hiccup_done handshake from hiccup_timer is registered once more at the top level before the supervisor, so the cool-down end is acted on one clock late
mutants.reason: Each hiccup cool-down lasts one clock longer than base << strike_level, so En rises again for the soft-start retry one clock later than it should.

mutants.description: A completed ramp outranks a soft-start overcurrent trip: window_trip_SS is masked by SS_done at the supervisor, so a same-clock trip hands over to S_RUN instead of hiccuping
mutants.reason: If window_trip_SS asserts on the clock SS_done rises, the FSM goes to S_RUN with En held high instead of to S_HICCUP. The trip is lost, because window_trip_SS is only produced in S_SS, so there is no hiccup and no strike.
